verdict.rationale: Nitrokey makes hardware security keys and HSM appliances: FIDO2, OTP, OpenPGP, PIV, and a NetHSM REST API. A user-defined, event-triggered automation rules engine is a workflow-automation axis that falls outside this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Nitrokey shipping any rules or trigger capability, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
